# Overview {-}

This mini tutorial is an introduction in basic  _R_ skills for psychologists of the course *Data Science*.  Students will get a basic understanding of the programming language R.

_R_ is a free software environment for statistical computing and data visualization that has become in the last couple of years the de-facto-standard tool for advanced statistics and reproducible research in psychology and social sciences.

**Learning Objectives**

At the end of the course the student will be able to develop scripts in the programming language R. The acquired data science skills comprise

* basics of programming in R
* reading data files in different formats


**Manual**

This manual guides you though the _R_ course and explains all concepts you need to know and points to relevant online resources.

A __PDF__ version of this tutorial can be downloaded, if you click on the little PDF symbol behind the title on the top-left.
